Last season I used one 50kg bag of NPK fertilizer from the subsidy program and my maize did well, so this year I will apply the same one bag on this plot, and I will also put chicken manure in the planting holes. I will plant hybrid seed because I saved some from last year's subsidy pack, and I will pull weeds by hand because I cannot afford chemicals. Between my family members we will spend about twenty days on this plot, and I will not hire any outside labor because I do not have the money.
